summary: Vylor Inc., formerly Seed External Spinco Inc., filed an 8-K reporting that on October 1, 2026 it completed its separation from Corteva, Inc. and EIDP, Inc. into two independent NYSE-listed companies. On October 9, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Indiana granted a temporary restraining order sought by 15 states and one sovereign challenging the Separation, barring out-of-ordinary-course asset dispositions and dividends or buybacks. The court stayed the Order on October 10 pending a Seventh Circuit emergency motion; Vylor contests the claims. Watch appellate timing and dividend/buyback overhang.
